metadata.description: Existing Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace in this resource group.
Leave false until schema, overlap and tenant-data validation are complete.
Requires MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs on the Analytics plan.
Alternative to overlapping Defender D001; requires native risk visibility.

properties.displayName: Entra sequence - device-code sign-in then security-method registration
properties.description: Successful device-code sign-in followed within two hours by successful individual-method registration for the same directory and target user. Identity/time correlation, not proof of phishing or same-session activity. Legitimate onboarding is a known false positive.
properties.query:
let QueryLookback = 4h;
let CorrelationWindow = 2h;
let EmissionWindow = 2h;
let ExcludedUserIds = dynamic([]);
let MethodRegistrations = materialize(
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(QueryLookback) and TimeGenerated <= now()
    | where Result =~ "success"
    | where OperationName in~ ("User registered security info", "User registered security information")
    | mv-expand Target = TargetResources
    | where tostring(Target.type) =~ "User"
    | extend EntraTenantId = tolower(AADTenantId), TargetUserId = tolower(tostring(Target.id)),
        TargetUPN = tolower(tostring(Target.userPrincipalName)),
        MethodTime = TimeGenerated, MethodEventId = tostring(Id),
        ActorUserId = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id)),
        ActorUPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
        MethodIPAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(EntraTenantId) and isnotempty(TargetUserId) and isnotempty(MethodEventId)
    | where TargetUserId !in (ExcludedUserIds)
    | project EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, TargetUPN, MethodTime, MethodEventId,
        ActorUserId, ActorUPN, MethodIPAddress, MethodOperation = OperationName
    | distinct *
);
let DeviceCodeSignIns = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(QueryLookback) and TimeGenerated <= now()
    | where tostring(ResultType) == "0" and AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode"
    | extend EntraTenantId = tolower(AADTenantId), TargetUserId = tolower(UserId)
    | where isnotempty(EntraTenantId) and isnotempty(TargetUserId)
    | project EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, SignInTime = TimeGenerated,
        SignInId = tostring(Id), SignInIPAddress = IPAddress, ClientAppId = AppId;
MethodRegistrations
| where MethodTime > ago(EmissionWindow)
| join kind=inner DeviceCodeSignIns on EntraTenantId, TargetUserId
| where SignInTime <= MethodTime and MethodTime - SignInTime <= CorrelationWindow
| summarize arg_max(SignInTime, *) by EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, MethodEventId
| extend TimeGenerated = MethodTime, AccountObjectId = TargetUserId,
    IPAddress = SignInIPAddress, AlertKey = strcat("S001:", EntraTenantId, ":", MethodEventId)
| project TimeGenerated, EntraTenantId, AccountObjectId, TargetUPN, IPAddress,
    SignInTime, SignInId, ClientAppId, MethodTime, MethodEventId,
    ActorUserId, ActorUPN, MethodIPAddress, MethodOperation, AlertKey

properties.displayName: Entra sequence - security-method registration then multi-surface Graph reads
properties.description: Successful individual-method registration followed within two hours by at least 25 distinct successful GET requests across at least three Graph resource surfaces, by the same directory/user/application. Reads can be benign; this does not establish content download or exfiltration.
properties.query:
let QueryLookback = 4h;
let CorrelationWindow = 2h;
let EmissionWindow = 2h;
let MinimumRequests = 25;
let MinimumSurfaces = 3;
let ExcludedUserIds = dynamic([]);
let ExcludedAppIds = dynamic([]);
let MethodRegistrations = materialize(
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(QueryLookback) and TimeGenerated <= now()
    | where Result =~ "success"
    | where OperationName in~ ("User registered security info", "User registered security information")
    | mv-expand Target = TargetResources
    | where tostring(Target.type) =~ "User"
    | extend EntraTenantId = tolower(AADTenantId), TargetUserId = tolower(tostring(Target.id)),
        TargetUPN = tolower(tostring(Target.userPrincipalName)),
        MethodTime = TimeGenerated, MethodEventId = tostring(Id),
        ActorUserId = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id)),
        ActorUPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
        MethodIPAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(EntraTenantId) and isnotempty(TargetUserId) and isnotempty(MethodEventId)
    | where TargetUserId !in (ExcludedUserIds)
    | project EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, TargetUPN, MethodTime, MethodEventId,
        ActorUserId, ActorUPN, MethodIPAddress, MethodOperation = OperationName
    | distinct *
);
let GraphReads = MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(QueryLookback) and TimeGenerated <= now()
    | where RequestMethod =~ "GET" and ResponseStatusCode between (200 .. 299)
    | extend EntraTenantId = tolower(AadTenantId), TargetUserId = tolower(UserId),
        GraphAppId = tolower(AppId), GraphTime = TimeGenerated,
        RequestPath = tolower(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path))
    | extend Surface = extract(@"^/(?:v1\.0|beta)/(users|groups|rolemanagement|applications|serviceprincipals|sites|drives)(?:/|$)", 1, RequestPath)
    | where isnotempty(EntraTenantId) and isnotempty(TargetUserId)
        and isnotempty(GraphAppId) and isnotempty(RequestId) and isnotempty(Surface)
    | where GraphAppId !in (ExcludedAppIds)
    | project EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, GraphAppId, GraphTime, Surface,
        RequestId, GraphIPAddress = IPAddress;
MethodRegistrations
| join kind=inner GraphReads on EntraTenantId, TargetUserId
| where GraphTime >= MethodTime and GraphTime - MethodTime <= CorrelationWindow
| summarize FirstGraphTime = min(GraphTime), LastGraphTime = max(GraphTime),
    RequestCount = count_distinct(RequestId), SurfaceCount = count_distinct(Surface),
    Surfaces = make_set(Surface, 10), GraphIPAddresses = make_set(GraphIPAddress, 20)
    by EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, TargetUPN, MethodTime, MethodEventId, GraphAppId
| where RequestCount >= MinimumRequests and SurfaceCount >= MinimumSurfaces
| where LastGraphTime > ago(EmissionWindow)
| extend TimeGenerated = LastGraphTime, AccountObjectId = TargetUserId,
    AlertKey = strcat("S002:", EntraTenantId, ":", MethodEventId, ":", GraphAppId)
| project TimeGenerated, EntraTenantId, AccountObjectId, TargetUPN, MethodTime,
    MethodEventId, GraphAppId, FirstGraphTime, LastGraphTime, RequestCount,
    SurfaceCount, Surfaces, GraphIPAddresses, AlertKey

properties.displayName: Entra sequence - native risky sign-in then security-method registration
properties.description: Successful medium/high native-risk sign-in followed within two hours by successful individual-method registration for the same directory/user. Enriches existing Microsoft risk evidence; not a new token detector. Choose this or overlapping Defender D001 for alerting, not both without a deduplication plan.
properties.query:
let QueryLookback = 4h;
let CorrelationWindow = 2h;
let EmissionWindow = 2h;
let ExcludedUserIds = dynamic([]);
let MethodRegistrations = materialize(
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(QueryLookback) and TimeGenerated <= now()
    | where Result =~ "success"
    | where OperationName in~ ("User registered security info", "User registered security information")
    | mv-expand Target = TargetResources
    | where tostring(Target.type) =~ "User"
    | extend EntraTenantId = tolower(AADTenantId), TargetUserId = tolower(tostring(Target.id)),
        TargetUPN = tolower(tostring(Target.userPrincipalName)),
        MethodTime = TimeGenerated, MethodEventId = tostring(Id),
        ActorUserId = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id)),
        ActorUPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
        MethodIPAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(EntraTenantId) and isnotempty(TargetUserId) and isnotempty(MethodEventId)
    | where TargetUserId !in (ExcludedUserIds)
    | project EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, TargetUPN, MethodTime, MethodEventId,
        ActorUserId, ActorUPN, MethodIPAddress, MethodOperation = OperationName
    | distinct *
);
let RiskySignIns = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(QueryLookback) and TimeGenerated <= now()
    | where tostring(ResultType) == "0" and RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ("medium", "high")
    | extend EntraTenantId = tolower(AADTenantId), TargetUserId = tolower(UserId)
    | where isnotempty(EntraTenantId) and isnotempty(TargetUserId)
    | project EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, SignInTime = TimeGenerated,
        SignInId = tostring(Id), SignInIPAddress = IPAddress,
        NativeRiskLevel = RiskLevelDuringSignIn;
MethodRegistrations
| where MethodTime > ago(EmissionWindow)
| join kind=inner RiskySignIns on EntraTenantId, TargetUserId
| where SignInTime <= MethodTime and MethodTime - SignInTime <= CorrelationWindow
| summarize arg_max(SignInTime, *) by EntraTenantId, TargetUserId, MethodEventId
| extend TimeGenerated = MethodTime, AccountObjectId = TargetUserId,
    IPAddress = SignInIPAddress, AlertKey = strcat("S003:", EntraTenantId, ":", MethodEventId)
| project TimeGenerated, EntraTenantId, AccountObjectId, TargetUPN, IPAddress,
    SignInTime, SignInId, NativeRiskLevel, MethodTime, MethodEventId,
    ActorUserId, ActorUPN, MethodIPAddress, MethodOperation, AlertKey
